about_the_game:
Adds a BGM pack of previous Atelier series songs that can be used to change the background music in the game.
Includes a special selection of over 1,000 songs from past Atelier series titles, ranging from "Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg" to "Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy."

Note: This content will be displayed in English for some languages. The BGM pack is accessible after unlocking base building and placing a Gramophone. Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.
